History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset of chest pain earlier today during gardening (mild physical exertion)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Chest pain is central in location.
Chest pain radiates to the shoulder and neck.
Chest pain is associated with nausea.
Chest pain is associated with sweatiness.
Chest pain is associated with palpitations.
Pain is still present at the time of assessment.
Patient reports no previous similar episodes of chest pain.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has a mild allergy to aspirin.

Family_History.content: There is a family history of ischemic heart disease.

Physical_Findings.content: Patient was examined while seated at rest.
Patient appears well perfused on video inspection.
Patient is not short of breath.

Assessment.content: Impression is an acute cardiac event.
Assessment.source_text: Imp: acute cardiac event- needs urgent ECG + trop T

Plan_of_Care.content: Urgent ECG and troponin T are required.
Ambulance (LAS) was called with blue lights.
Front door left open to allow paramedic access if patient collapses.
